### Elektromagnetizm

Groups: 8 · Skills: 31

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Electric charges, currents, and magnetic fields describe related interactions; electricity and magnetism share underlying principles but begin with different observations.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Elektr zariadtary, toktar jäne magnit örısterı qalai ärekettesetının zertte.

#### Ötkızgışter men oqşaulağyştar

Skills: 2

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/conductorsAndInsulators/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Materials differ in how readily they permit electric charge to move; distinguish an electrical property of a material from a device's purpose.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Nege keibır materialdarda zariadtar basqalaryna qarağanda oñai qozğalatynyn bıl.

##### Elektr ötkızgış materialdardy anyqtau

[identifyElectricallyConductiveMaterials.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/conductorsAndInsulators/identifyElectricallyConductiveMaterials.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine experimentally which materials complete a low-voltage circuit.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qauıpsız tömen kerneulı tızbekte qandai materialdar tok ötkızetının tekser.

##### Elektr oqşaulağyş materialdardy anyqtau

[identifyElectricallyInsulatingMaterials.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/conductorsAndInsulators/identifyElectricallyInsulatingMaterials.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine experimentally which materials impede the flow of current.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Elektr togyn toqtatatyn nemese edäuır şekteitın materialdardy anyqta.

#### Tok, kerneu jäne kedergı

Skills: 5

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/currentVoltageAndResistance/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Current describes the flow of electric charge, voltage is a potential difference, and resistance is opposition to current under specified physical conditions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tok, kerneu, kedergı jäne quat elektr tızbekterın qalai sipattaitynyn bıl.

##### Elektr togyn tüsındıru

[explainElectricCurrent.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/currentVoltageAndResistance/explainElectricCurrent.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Electric current involves directed transport of charge, not merely random motion of charge carriers.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Elektr togyn zariadtardyñ bağyttalğan qozğalysy retınde tüsın.

##### Elektr kerneuın tüsındıru

[explainElectricVoltage.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/currentVoltageAndResistance/explainElectricVoltage.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Voltage specifies the difference in electric potential between two points and is not current itself.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Kerneudı ekı nüktenıñ elektrlık potentsialdar aiyrmasy retınde tüsındır.

##### Elektr quatyn tüsındıru

[explainElectricalPower.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/currentVoltageAndResistance/explainElectricalPower.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Electrical power describes the rate of electrical energy transfer or transformation.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Elektr quatyn energiianyñ berılu jyldamdyğy retınde tüsın.

##### Elektr kedergısın tüsındıru

[explainElectricalResistance.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/currentVoltageAndResistance/explainElectricalResistance.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Resistance determines the relationship between voltage and current under given conditions and depends on conductor material and geometry.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Belgılı jağdailarda kedergı tokqa qalai äser etetının zertte.

##### Omdyq ötkızgış üşın Om zañyn tüsındıru

[explainOhmsLawForAnOhmicConductor.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/currentVoltageAndResistance/explainOhmsLawForAnOhmicConductor.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Under constant conditions, the current through an ohmic conductor is directly proportional to voltage; this law does not describe every component without exception.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tūraqty jağdailarda omdyq ötkızgışterge Om zañyn qoldan.

#### Elektr jäne magnit örısterı

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricAndMagneticFields/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Fields describe interactions involving electric charges and magnetic systems without direct contact, but their physical effects differ.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Elektr jäne magnit örısterı türlı küştermen qalai äser etetının bıl.

##### Elektr örısterın magnit örısterınen ajyratu

[distinguishElectricFromMagneticFields.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricAndMagneticFields/distinguishElectricFromMagneticFields.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** An electric field can act on a stationary charge, whereas the magnetic component of the force on a charge depends on its motion.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tynyştyqtağy zariadqa äser etetın elektr küşın qozğalatyn zariadqa äser etetın magnit küşınen ajyrat.

##### Elektr örısın tüsındıru

[explainTheElectricField.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricAndMagneticFields/explainTheElectricField.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** An electric field determines the force on an electric charge and exists independently of a test charge.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Elektr örısı tıkelei janaspai-aq zariadqa qalai äser etetının tüsın.

##### Magnit örısın tüsındıru

[explainTheMagneticField.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricAndMagneticFields/explainTheMagneticField.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A magnetic field can act on moving charges and magnetic systems; the direction and magnitude of its effects depend on conditions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Magnit örısı qozğalatyn zariadtar men magnittık denelerge qalai äser etetının tüsındır.

#### Elektr zariadtary jäne özara ärekettesu

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricChargesAndInteractions/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Electrification, interactions between charged bodies, and charge transfer obey conservation of electric charge. Electric interaction can occur without direct contact.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Elektr zariadtary qalai berılıp, küştermen äser etetının bıl.

##### Elektr zariadtarynyñ tartyluy men tebıluın ajyratu

[distinguishAttractionFromRepulsionBetweenElectricCharges.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricChargesAndInteractions/distinguishAttractionFromRepulsionBetweenElectricCharges.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Like charges repel and unlike charges attract; electric interaction is distinct from magnetic interaction.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ärtürlı tañbaly zariadtardyñ tartyluyn bırdei tañbaly zariadtardyñ tebıluınen ajyrat.

##### Elektr zariadynyñ saqtaluyn tüsındıru

[explainConservationOfElectricCharge.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricChargesAndInteractions/explainConservationOfElectricCharge.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The total charge of an isolated system is conserved during charge transfer and physical interactions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Zariad berılgende jalpy elektr zariady nege özgermeitının tüsındır.

##### Üikelıs arqyly denelerdıñ zariadtaluyn tanu

[recognizeTheChargingOfObjectsByFriction.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricChargesAndInteractions/recognizeTheChargingOfObjectsByFriction.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Using a safe balloon or comb model, connect friction with electrostatic effects rather than attributing them to magnetic attraction.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Keibır denelerdı üikegende elektrostatikalyq qūbylystar qalai paida bolatynyn anyqta.

#### Elektr tızbekterı

Skills: 9

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricCircuits/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** An electric circuit needs a conducting path, a source, and components whose interactions determine the operation of a safe model.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qarapaiym tızbekterde közder, ajyratqyştar men tūtynuşylar qalai bırge jūmys ısteitının zertte.

##### Aşyq elektr tızbegın tüsındıru

[explainAnOpenCircuit.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricCircuits/explainAnOpenCircuit.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Opening a branch interrupts its conducting path; in a circuit with parallel branches, other parts may continue to operate.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tok joly üzılgende ne bolatynyn tüsındır.

##### Tızbek tüiınındegı tok teñgerımın tüsındıru

[explainCurrentBalanceAtACircuitNode.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricCircuits/explainCurrentBalanceAtACircuitNode.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Under steady current, charge does not accumulate at a node; the total current entering equals the total current leaving.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tūraqty küide tüiınge kıretın toktardyñ qosyndysy şyğatyn toktar qosyndysyna nege teñ ekenın tüsındır.

##### Tızbek elementterınıñ parallel qosyluyn tüsındıru

[explainParallelConnectionsOfElectricCircuitComponents.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricCircuits/explainParallelConnectionsOfElectricCircuitComponents.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Parallel branches connect to the same two nodes, so each has the same voltage and the total current is divided among the branches. Opening one branch does not necessarily stop current in the others.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Parallel tarmaqtardağy kerneu bırdei, al tok tarmaqtarğa bölınetının tüsın.

##### Tızbek elementterınıñ tızbektei qosyluyn tüsındıru

[explainSeriesConnectionsOfElectricCircuitComponents.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricCircuits/explainSeriesConnectionsOfElectricCircuitComponents.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Components connected in series share a common current path: the same current passes through each, and the total voltage across the combination is the sum of the voltages across the individual components. Breaking the single path stops current through all those components.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tızbektei qosylğan elementterdıñ bärınen bırdei tok qalai ötetının zertte.

##### Elektr energiiasyn tūtynuşyny anyqtau

[identifyAConsumerOfElectricalEnergy.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricCircuits/identifyAConsumerOfElectricalEnergy.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** An electrical load converts received electrical energy into thermal, mechanical, light, or other forms, rather than merely "using current."

**User-friendly description (kk):** Elektr energiiasyn basqa türlerge türlendıretın jüktemelerdı tany.

##### Elektr energiiasy közın anyqtau

[identifyAnElectricalPowerSource.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricCircuits/identifyAnElectricalPowerSource.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A source maintains a potential difference between its terminals and converts other forms of energy into electrical energy, unlike a passive conductor.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tızbektegı potentsialdar aiyrmasyn ūstap tūratyn elementtı anyqta.

##### Ajyratqyştyñ qyzmetın anyqtau

[identifyTheFunctionOfASwitch.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricCircuits/identifyTheFunctionOfASwitch.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A switch changes the state of a conducting path and can interrupt current in a particular branch, but it is not itself an energy source.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ajyratqyş tok jolyn qalai qosatynyn nemese üzetının tüsındır.

##### Tızbektegı ajyratqyş äserın boljau

[predictTheEffectOfASwitchInACircuit.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricCircuits/predictTheEffectOfASwitchInACircuit.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The consequences of switching depend on where the switch is placed relative to the source, loads, and parallel paths.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ajyratqyş tızbektıñ qai bölıkterın qosatynyn ne öşıretının bolja.

##### Tūiyq elektr tızbegın tanu

[recognizeAClosedElectricCircuit.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricCircuits/recognizeAClosedElectricCircuit.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A closed circuit has a continuous conducting path; sustained current also requires a source of electromotive force.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tızbekte üzdıksız ötkızgış jol bar-joğyn anyqta.

#### Elektromagnitter jäne induktsiia

Skills: 2

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electromagnetsAndInduction/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Electric current can create a magnetic field, and changing magnetic conditions can produce electrical effects, explaining many systems.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Toktar magnit örısterın qalai tudyratynyn jäne özgermelı örıster tokty qalai induktsiialaitynyn bıl.

##### İnduktsiialyq toktyñ paida boluyn tüsındıru

[explainHowInducedCurrentArises.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electromagnetsAndInduction/explainHowInducedCurrentArises.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A changing magnetic flux through a closed conducting loop can induce an electromotive force and current; constant flux by itself does not generate current.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Magnit ağyny özgergende induktsiialyq tok qaşan paida bolatynyn anyqta.

##### Elektr togynyñ magnittık äserın tüsındıru

[explainTheMagneticEffectOfElectricCurrent.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electromagnetsAndInduction/explainTheMagneticEffectOfElectricCurrent.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Moving electric charges create a magnetic field; changing the current changes the field it produces and the associated magnetic interactions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Elektr togy magnit örısın nege tudyratynyn tüsındır.

#### Fizikalyq jüielerdegı magnittık äserler

Skills: 1

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/magneticEffectsInPhysicalSystems/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Magnetic forces in real systems are explained by fields and material properties; choosing an engineering design belongs to Engineering.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Magnit örısterınıñ fizikalyq jüielerge äserın zertte.

##### Jüiedegı magnit örısınıñ fizikalyq rölın tüsındıru

[explainThePhysicalRoleOfAMagneticFieldInASystem.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/magneticEffectsInPhysicalSystems/explainThePhysicalRoleOfAMagneticFieldInASystem.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine how magnetic interaction affects a system's motion or state without proceeding to select a technical component.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Magnit örısı qozğalysqa nemese özge fizikalyq küige qalai äser etetının tüsındır.

#### Magnittık qasietter men özara ärekettesuler

Skills: 6

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/magneticPropertiesAndInteractions/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Materials and pole orientation affect interactions; direct contact between magnets is not required.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Magnittık materialdar men poliusterdıñ qalai ärekettesetının zertte.

##### Denelerdı magnittık ärekettesu boiynşa jıkteu

[classifyObjectsByMagneticInteraction.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/magneticPropertiesAndInteractions/classifyObjectsByMagneticInteraction.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Classification is based on the direction and magnitude of a material's magnetic response under relevant conditions; this is not the same as determining whether it has its own magnetic field.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Denelerdı olardyñ magnittık jauabyna qarai jıkte.

##### Janaspai magnittık äser etudı tüsındıru

[explainMagneticActionWithoutContact.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/magneticPropertiesAndInteractions/explainMagneticActionWithoutContact.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize magnetic force as an interaction that does not require direct contact.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Magnit denege timei-aq qalai küş tüsıretının tüsındır.

##### Magnitke tartylatyn materialdardy anyqtau

[identifyMaterialsAttractedToAMagnet.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/magneticPropertiesAndInteractions/identifyMaterialsAttractedToAMagnet.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The observable effect of a magnetic field on a material depends on its magnetic properties; not all metals are attracted equally.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Magnit örısıne küştı äserlenetın materialdardy tany.

##### Magnit poliusterınıñ ärekettesuın boljau

[predictInteractionsBetweenMagneticPoles.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/magneticPropertiesAndInteractions/predictInteractionsBetweenMagneticPoles.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine attraction or repulsion from a known arrangement of poles.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Belgılı magnit poliusterın jaqyndatqanda ne bolatynyn bolja.

##### Magnittık tartyludy tanu

[recognizeMagneticAttraction.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/magneticPropertiesAndInteractions/recognizeMagneticAttraction.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify a situation in which magnets move toward one another due to their interaction.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Magnitter bırın-bırı tartatyn jağdailardy anyqta.

##### Magnittık tebıludı tanu

[recognizeMagneticRepulsion.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/magneticPropertiesAndInteractions/recognizeMagneticRepulsion.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify a situation in which magnets move apart due to their interaction.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Magnitter bırın-bırı tebetın jağdailardy anyqta.

### Energiia

Groups: 4 · Skills: 12

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Energy is a quantity that helps describe physical changes and connect phenomena involving motion, heating, light, and electricity. The emphasis is on energy transfer, transformation, and conservation rather than arithmetic formulas.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Fizikalyq jüielerde energiia qalai jinalyp, berılıp, türlenıp jäne saqtalatynyn zertte.

#### Energiianyñ saqtaluy

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/conservationOfEnergy/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The total energy of an isolated system is conserved even as its form or distribution among bodies changes. A decrease in energy available for useful work is not its disappearance; for an open system, exchange with the surroundings must be considered.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Oqşaulanğan jüienıñ tolyq energiiasy nege saqtalatynyn tüsın.

##### Energiianyñ saqtalu zañyn tüsındıru

[explainTheLawOfConservationOfEnergy.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/conservationOfEnergy/explainTheLawOfConservationOfEnergy.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The total energy of an isolated system remains unchanged; for an open system, energy exchange with the surroundings must be taken into account.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Pışını nemese orny özgerse de energiianyñ qalai saqtalatynyn tüsındır.

##### Paidaly energiianyñ azaiuyn tüsındıru

[explainTheLossOfUsefulEnergy.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/conservationOfEnergy/explainTheLossOfUsefulEnergy.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Dissipation into forms of energy less suitable for a particular task reduces a process's usefulness but does not violate conservation of total energy.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Paidasy tömen türlerge tarağan energiia joiylmaitynyn bıl.

##### Energiia joğalady degen oidy joqqa şyğaru

[refuteTheIdeaThatEnergyDisappears.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/conservationOfEnergy/refuteTheIdeaThatEnergyDisappears.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify unaccounted energy transfers and transformations instead of attributing a system's change of state to energy disappearing.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Energiia joğaldy demei, qaida ketkenın anyqta.

#### Energiianyñ berıluı men türlenuı

Skills: 2

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/energyTransferAndTransformation/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Energy can pass between objects and change form; the sequence of events matters more than the name of a particular device.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Energiianyñ deneler arasynda qalai berılıp, türlenetının bıl.

##### Fizikalyq üderıstegı energiia türlenuın tüsındıru

[explainEnergyTransformationInAPhysicalProcess.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/energyTransferAndTransformation/explainEnergyTransformationInAPhysicalProcess.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Energy changes form during physical processes, for example when energy shifts between motion and position; the total energy of an isolated system is conserved.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Energiia saqtaluyn eskerıp, onyñ türlenuın baqyla.

##### Deneler arasyndağy energiia berıluın anyqtau

[identifyEnergyTransferBetweenBodies.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/energyTransferAndTransformation/identifyEnergyTransferBetweenBodies.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Using colliding balls or water heating, show which body transfers energy to which other body.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Özara äreketteskende qai dene ekınşısıne energiia beretının anyqta.

#### Energiia türlerı

Skills: 5

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/formsOfEnergy/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Motion, position, deformation, and internal state can be associated with different forms of energy; descriptions should refer to a specific physical system.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Özgeretın fizikalyq jağdailarda energiianyñ ärtürlı türlerın tany.

##### Gravitatsiialyq potentsialdyq energiiany esepteu

[calculateGravitationalPotentialEnergy.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/formsOfEnergy/calculateGravitationalPotentialEnergy.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine the change in a body's gravitational potential energy near Earth's surface from its mass, gravitational acceleration, and change in height, correctly accounting for the chosen reference level and units. This calculation assumes an approximately uniform gravitational field and differs from calculating elastic potential energy.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Massa, auyrlyq üdeuı jäne biıktık arqyly potentsialdyq energiianyñ özgerısın esepte.

##### Energiia türlerın jıkteu

[classifyFormsOfEnergy.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/formsOfEnergy/classifyFormsOfEnergy.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish energy of motion, energy related to bodies' positions, elastic deformation energy, and internal energy based on the physical properties of a system.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qozğalys, oryn, deformatsiia jäne ışkı küi energiiasyn ajyrat.

##### Energiiany onyñ közınen ajyratu

[distinguishEnergyFromItsSource.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/formsOfEnergy/distinguishEnergyFromItsSource.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Energy characterizes the state and changes of a system, whereas a source is a body or process from which energy is transferred to another system; the source does not create it from nothing.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jüienıñ energiiasyn oğan energiia beretın közden ajyrat.

##### Kinetikalyq energiiany qozğalys energiiasy dep tüsındıru

[explainKineticEnergyAsEnergyOfMotion.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/formsOfEnergy/explainKineticEnergyAsEnergyOfMotion.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Kinetic energy is associated with a body's motion relative to a reference frame and depends on mass and speed, but it is not the same as momentum.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Denenıñ massasy men jyldamdyğy onyñ kinetikalyq energiiasyna qalai äser etetının tüsındır.

##### Potentsialdyq energiiany tüsındıru

[explainPotentialEnergy.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/formsOfEnergy/explainPotentialEnergy.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Potential energy is related to a physical system's configuration and interactions among its components, including bodies' positions in a gravitational field or elastic deformation. Its value is specified relative to a chosen zero level; this competency addresses physical meaning rather than calculation.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Potentsialdyq energiianyñ ornalasu men tañdalğan esepteu deñgeiıne täueldılıgın tüsın.

#### Jūmys pen quat

Skills: 2

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/workAndPower/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Work describes energy transfer by a force during displacement, while power describes the rate of energy transfer.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Mehanikalyq jūmys pen quattyñ fizikalyq mağynasyn zertte.

##### Mehanikalyq jūmysty tüsındıru

[explainMechanicalWork.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/workAndPower/explainMechanicalWork.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Mechanical work involves the component of force along displacement; exerting force without displacement does not perform mechanical work.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Küş denenı oryn auystyrğanda energiia nege berıletının tüsındır.

##### Quattyñ fizikalyq mağynasyn tüsındıru

[explainThePhysicalMeaningOfPower.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/workAndPower/explainThePhysicalMeaningOfPower.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Power describes the rate of doing work or transferring energy and is not a separate form of energy.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Quatty energiia berıluınıñ nemese jūmys atqarudyñ jyldamdyğy dep tüsın.

### Sūiyqtar men gazdar mehanikasy

Groups: 4 · Skills: 15

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Water and air transmit pressure, flow, resist bodies' motion, and can provide buoyancy. Familiar containers, floating objects, and airflow make these phenomena accessible.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Sūiyqtar men gazdardyñ ağyp, qysym tüsırıp, qozğalğan denelerge qalai äser etetının zertte.

#### Aerodinamika

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/aerodynamics/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Air exerts drag on moving bodies; shape and relative speed affect the interaction. Building aircraft or designing hulls are Engineering applications.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Auanyñ ışındegı qozğalğan denelerge äserın bıl.

##### Aerodinamikalyq kötergış küştı tüsındıru

[explainAerodynamicLift.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/aerodynamics/explainAerodynamicLift.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Airflow interacting with a body can produce a force perpendicular to the flow; it should not be explained solely by differences in air-path length.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Aua joldary teñ degen qate tüsınıkke süienbei, ağyn kötergış küştı qalai jasaitynyn zertte.

##### Qozğalys kezındegı aua kedergısınıñ sebebın tüsındıru

[explainTheOriginOfAirResistanceDuringMotion.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/aerodynamics/explainTheOriginOfAirResistanceDuringMotion.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Using a paper sheet or ball, connect drag to the body's interaction with air; do not claim that drag arises only from an unsuitable shape.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Auada qozğalu nelıkten kedergı tudyratynyn tüsındır.

##### Pışınnıñ auadağy qozğalysqa äserın boljau

[predictTheEffectOfShapeOnMotionThroughAir.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/aerodynamics/predictTheEffectOfShapeOnMotionThroughAir.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A body's shape and orientation affect airflow around it, drag, and, under certain conditions, lift.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Denenıñ pışını ne būryşy kedergı men kötergış küştı qalai özgertetının bolja.

#### Jüzu jäne kerı iteruşı küş

Skills: 5

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/floatingAndBuoyancy/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A body's behavior in water is determined by gravity together with forces exerted by the liquid; material and shape may affect the outcome through average density.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tyğyzdyq pen kerı iteruşı küş denenıñ jüzuın ne batuyn qalai anyqtaitynyn bıl.

##### Qalqyp şyğudy, jüzudı jäne batudy ajyratu

[distinguishRisingFloatingAndSinking.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/floatingAndBuoyancy/distinguishRisingFloatingAndSinking.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify three possible behaviors of safe objects in water through observation or simulation.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Suda denenıñ qalqyp şyğuyn, jüzıp tūruyn nemese batuyn ajyrat.

##### Arhimed zañyn tüsındıru

[explainArchimedesPrinciple.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/floatingAndBuoyancy/explainArchimedesPrinciple.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Under the relevant conditions, the buoyant force equals the weight of the volume of liquid or gas displaced by the body.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Arhimed zañymen kerı iteruşı küş pen yğystyrylğan sūiyqtyñ arasyn bailanystyr.

##### Kerı iteruşı küştı tüsındıru

[explainBuoyantForce.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/floatingAndBuoyancy/explainBuoyantForce.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The pressure difference exerted by a liquid or gas on a submerged body produces a net upward force.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qysym aiyrmasy joğary bağyttalğan küştı qalai tudyratynyn tüsındır.

##### Tyğyzdyqty tüsındıru

[explainDensity.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/floatingAndBuoyancy/explainDensity.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Density is the mass per unit volume of a substance and helps determine the relationship between a body's properties and those of the surrounding medium.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tyğyzdyqty kölem bırlıgındegı massa retınde tüsın.

##### Jüktıñ jüzuge äserın boljau

[predictHowALoadAffectsFloating.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/floatingAndBuoyancy/predictHowALoadAffectsFloating.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Increasing the mass of a load changes the buoyant force and displaced volume needed for equilibrium, so a body may become more deeply submerged.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qosymşa salmaq jüzıp tūrğan denenıñ suğa qanşalyq tereñ batatynyn bolja.

#### Gidrodinamika

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/hydrodynamics/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Water and other liquids flow under certain conditions and resist bodies moving through the stream; comparison with air explains differences between the media.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Sudyñ ağysyn jäne ondağy deneler qozğalysyna kedergısın tüsın.

##### Su men auadağy qozğalys kedergısın salystyru

[compareResistanceToMotionInWaterAndAir.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/hydrodynamics/compareResistanceToMotionInWaterAndAir.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use qualitative examples to recognize why moving the same object through water and through air feels different.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bır denenıñ sudağy jäne auadağy qozğalys kedergısın salystyr.

##### Syğylmaityn sūiyq ağynynyñ üzdıksızdıgın tüsındıru

[explainContinuityOfIncompressibleFluidFlow.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/hydrodynamics/explainContinuityOfIncompressibleFluidFlow.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** For steady flow without leakage, a change in a channel's cross-sectional area is associated with a change in fluid speed.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Arna qimasynyñ özgerısın tūraqty syğylmaityn ağyn jyldamdyğymen bailanystyr.

##### Ärtürlı deñgeidegı ydystar arasynda sudyñ ağuyn tüsındıru

[explainWaterFlowBetweenContainersAtDifferentLevels.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/hydrodynamics/explainWaterFlowBetweenContainersAtDifferentLevels.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A hydrostatic pressure difference between connected vessels causes liquid to flow until pressures balance or other forces intervene.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ärtürlı deñgeidegı ydystar arasynda sudyñ nege ağatynyn tüsındır.

#### Sūiyqtar men gazdardağy qysym

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/pressureInLiquidsAndGases/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Pressure is transmitted through a medium and changes with depth in still water; container examples help distinguish pressure from the mere amount of water.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Sūiyqtar men gazdardağy qysymnyñ äreketın jäne jağdaiğa qarai özgerısın bıl.

##### Jabyq ydystağy sūiyqta qysym berıluın tüsındıru

[explainPressureTransmissionInAnEnclosedLiquid.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/pressureInLiquidsAndGases/explainPressureTransmissionInAnEnclosedLiquid.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A pressure change applied to an enclosed liquid at rest is transmitted in every direction, unlike the variation of hydrostatic pressure with depth.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jabyq ydystağy tynyş sūiyqta qysym özgerısı barlyq bağytta qalai berıletının tüsındır.

##### Su qysymynyñ tereñdıkpen nege artatynyn tüsındıru

[explainWhyWaterPressureIncreasesWithDepth.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/pressureInLiquidsAndGases/explainWhyWaterPressureIncreasesWithDepth.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** In a stationary liquid of constant density, pressure increases with depth because of the weight of the layers above; the container's shape alone does not determine it.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tynyş tūrğan sudyñ tereñırekte nege köbırek qysym tüsıretının tüsındır.

##### Gaz qysymynyñ mysaldaryn anyqtau

[identifyGasPressureInExamples.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/pressureInLiquidsAndGases/identifyGasPressureInExamples.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A gas acts on surfaces through collisions of its particles; pressure depends on the gas's physical state and the conditions of its confinement.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tūiyqtalğan gazdyñ ainalasyndağy betterge qysymyn anyqta.

##### Sūiyq qysymynyñ ärtürlı bağytta äserın tanu

[recognizeLiquidPressureActingInDifferentDirections.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/pressureInLiquidsAndGases/recognizeLiquidPressureActingInDifferentDirections.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use a model of holes in a container to explain why water exerts pressure in directions other than downward.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Sūiyq qysymy tömenge ğana emes, jan-jaqqa da äser etetının bıl.

### Küşter jäne özara äserlesuler

Groups: 3 · Skills: 14

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/forcesAndInteractions/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** When bodies touch or affect one another at a distance, their motion, shape, or state of equilibrium may change. This Domain covers general concepts of force, contact, gravity, and stability; specifically magnetic and electric phenomena belong to Electromagnetism.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Küşterdıñ qozğalysty qalai özgertetının, denelerdı qalai deformatsiialaitynyn jäne ornyqtylyqty qalai saqtaitynyn zertte.

#### Janasu küşterı men üikelıs

Skills: 5

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/forcesAndInteractions/contactForcesAndFriction/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Contact can produce pushing, pulling, and friction; the direction of interaction and surface properties affect motion.

**User-friendly description (kk):** İteru, tartu jäne üikelıs janasqan denelerge qalai äser etetının zertte.

##### Ärtürlı betterdegı qozğalysty salystyru

[compareMotionOnDifferentSurfaces.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/forcesAndInteractions/contactForcesAndFriction/compareMotionOnDifferentSurfaces.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interactions between contacting surfaces affect friction and resistance to sliding or rolling, changing mechanical motion under otherwise similar conditions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Üikelıstı eskere otyryp, ärtürlı betterdegı qozğalysty salystyr.

##### Toqtaudağy üikelıstıñ rölın tüsındıru

[explainTheRoleOfFrictionInStopping.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/forcesAndInteractions/contactForcesAndFriction/explainTheRoleOfFrictionInStopping.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Friction during sliding or rolling can reduce kinetic energy of motion, converting it into the internal energy of the bodies and surroundings.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Üikelıs qozğalysty qalai baiaulatatynyn jäne energiiany ainalağa qalai beretının tüsındır.

##### Küş bağytynyñ äserın boljau

[predictTheEffectOfForceDirection.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/forcesAndInteractions/contactForcesAndFriction/predictTheEffectOfForceDirection.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The direction of the net force relative to velocity determines whether motion speeds up, slows down, or changes direction.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Küş bağyty üdeuge, baiaulauğa nemese būryluğa qalai äser etetının bolja.

##### Tartu küşterın tanu

[recognizePullingForces.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/forcesAndInteractions/contactForcesAndFriction/recognizePullingForces.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Pulling is a contact interaction through a connection or grip, with force directed toward its source; it differs from pressure and pushing.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tartu küşın jäne onyñ äserı berıletın bailanysty tany.

##### İteru küşterın tanu

[recognizePushingForces.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/forcesAndInteractions/contactForcesAndFriction/recognizePushingForces.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A contact push transfers force from the acting body in the direction of pressure on another body; not every change in motion is caused by pushing.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bır denenıñ ekınşısın tıkelei janasu arqyly qalai iteretının tany.

#### Tepe-teñdık jäne ornyqtylyq

Skills: 6

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/forcesAndInteractions/equilibriumAndStability/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Balanced forces allow a body to remain at rest, while the arrangement of supports and loads affects a model's stability and deformation.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qūrylymdardy tepe-teñ jäne ornyqty küide ūstaityn küşterdı tüsın.

##### Ärtürlı pışındegı qūrylymdardyñ berıktıgın salystyru

[compareTheStrengthOfStructuralShapes.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/forcesAndInteractions/equilibriumAndStability/compareTheStrengthOfStructuralShapes.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Under identical testing conditions, determine which shape better withstands a load.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ärtürlı pışındegı qūrylymdardyñ bırdei jüktemege qalai tötep beretının salystyr.

##### Jüktemenıñ berıluın tüsındıru

[explainLoadTransfer.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/forcesAndInteractions/equilibriumAndStability/explainLoadTransfer.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify how forces from a load pass through structural elements to supports, and distinguish the force-transmission path from the shape of the structure.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jükteme küşı qūrylym bölıkterı arqyly tırekterge qalai berıletının baqyla.

##### Qūrylymnyñ tırek elementterın anyqtau

[identifyStructuralSupportElements.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/forcesAndInteractions/equilibriumAndStability/identifyStructuralSupportElements.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify the elements supporting a model bridge or building.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Modeldık qūrylymnyñ salmağyn köteretın bölıkterdı anyqta.

##### Qūrylymnyñ ornyqtylyğyn boljau

[predictStructuralStability.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/forcesAndInteractions/equilibriumAndStability/predictStructuralStability.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare the stability of two models using basic support-related characteristics.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tırekterı bar qai qūrylymdardyñ ornyqty qalu yqtimaldyğy joğary ekenın salystyr.

##### Massa tsentrınıñ orny ornyqtylyqqa qalai äser etetının boljau

[predictTheEffectOfCenterOfMassPositionOnStability.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/forcesAndInteractions/equilibriumAndStability/predictTheEffectOfCenterOfMassPositionOnStability.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The position of the center of mass relative to the support area affects whether a body can overturn under gravity.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Massa tsentrınıñ qai ornalasuy denenıñ audarylu yqtimaldyğyn arttyratynyn bolja.

##### Teñgerılgen küşterdı tanu

[recognizeBalancedForces.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/forcesAndInteractions/equilibriumAndStability/recognizeBalancedForces.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** When the net force is zero, there is no acceleration; a body may be at rest or continue moving uniformly in a straight line.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Dene qozğalyp tūrsa da teñgerılgen küşter üdeudı tuğyzbaitynyn tüsın.

#### Gravitatsiia

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/forcesAndInteractions/gravity/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Bodies with mass interact gravitationally even without touching. Earth's gravity governs falling near its surface, and other celestial bodies also exert gravitational influence.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Gravitatsiiany massasy bar denelerdıñ özara äserlesuı retınde zertte.

##### Dene massasyn Jerdıñ tartylys küşınen ajyratu

[distinguishABodysMassFromEarthsGravitationalForce.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/forcesAndInteractions/gravity/distinguishABodysMassFromEarthsGravitationalForce.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare a body's unchanged mass with gravitational force, which depends on the gravitational field, using models. Do not equate these quantities or confuse gravitational force with the body's weight as the force it exerts on a support.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Denenıñ massasyn oğan äser etetın tartylys küşınen ajyrat.

##### Denege Jerdıñ tartylys küşınıñ äserın tüsındıru

[explainEarthsGravitationalForceOnABody.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/forcesAndInteractions/gravity/explainEarthsGravitationalForceOnABody.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Earth exerts a gravitational force on a body depending on the body's mass and the gravitational field; distinguish that force from mass and from weight as the body's action on a support.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jerdıñ tartylysy denege nege küşpen äser etetının tüsın.

##### Qūlau bağytyn boljau

[predictTheDirectionOfFalling.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/forcesAndInteractions/gravity/predictTheDirectionOfFalling.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Near Earth's surface, gravity acts approximately toward Earth's center, so a body in free fall accelerates downward relative to the local vertical.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Erkın qūlağan denenı tartylys küşı qai bağytta üdetetının bolja.

### Ölşeu

Groups: 2 · Skills: 7

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/measurement/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Physical measurement connects an observable property to an agreed method of comparison through the choice of quantity, unit, and instrument. Its purpose is to make descriptions of phenomena reproducible without tying them to formulas or mathematics lessons.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Fizikterdıñ qasietterdı fizikalyq şamalar, bırlıkter jäne senımdı ädıster arqyly qalai ölşeitının zertte.

#### Aspaptar jäne ölşeu ädısterı

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/measurement/instrumentsAndMeasurementMethods/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** An instrument's reading depends on its scale, units, and correct use; the method of obtaining data matters as much as the number itself.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Aspaptar men mūqiiat qoldanylatyn ädısterdıñ fizikalyq ölşeulerdı qalai paidaly etetının bıl.

##### Qaitalanğan ölşeuler nege ärtürlı boluy mümkın ekenın tüsındıru

[explainWhyRepeatedMeasurementsMayDiffer.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/measurement/instrumentsAndMeasurementMethods/explainWhyRepeatedMeasurementsMayDiffer.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Repeated measurements can differ because of instrument precision limits, reading methods, or changing conditions; a difference in values does not always mean that the measured phenomenon has changed.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bır denenı qaita ölşegende de körsetkışter nege ärtürlı bolatynyn tüsındır.

##### Qarapaiym ölşeu aspabynyñ körsetkışın oqu

[readASimpleMeasuringInstrument.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/measurement/instrumentsAndMeasurementMethods/readASimpleMeasuringInstrument.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Correctly relate the measured quantity to the position of a pointer on a scale, its units, and the zero reference; a reading has physical meaning only under the relevant measurement conditions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Aspaptyñ tılşesın, şkalasyn, bırlıgın jäne nöldık belgısın dūrys oqy.

##### Termometrden temperaturany oqu

[readTemperatureFromAThermometer.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/measurement/instrumentsAndMeasurementMethods/readTemperatureFromAThermometer.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate the position of a pointer or liquid column to the temperature scale and units, accounting for the scale origin and measurement limits.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Temperaturany anyqtau üşın termometr şkalasy men bırlıkterın oqy.

#### Fizikalyq şamalar men bırlıkter

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/measurement/physicalQuantitiesAndUnits/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A single object can be described using different quantities; comparisons of the same quantity require compatible units and observation conditions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Fizikalyq qasietterdı tiıstı ölşemder men bırlıkter arqyly sipattaudy üiren.

##### Bır şamanyñ ölşeulerın salystyru

[compareMeasurementsOfTheSameQuantity.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/measurement/physicalQuantitiesAndUnits/compareMeasurementsOfTheSameQuantity.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Given consistent units and clearly stated conditions, determine which measured value is larger or smaller; this is physical interpretation, not arithmetic practice.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bırdei jağdailarda jäne üilesımdı bırlıkterde jasalğan ölşeulerdı salystyr.

##### Fizikalyq şamany onyñ ölşem bırlıgınen ajyratu

[distinguishAPhysicalQuantityFromItsUnitOfMeasurement.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/measurement/physicalQuantitiesAndUnits/distinguishAPhysicalQuantityFromItsUnitOfMeasurement.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A physical quantity describes a property of a body or phenomenon, whereas a unit establishes an agreed scale for expressing it numerically; length and centimeter serve different roles.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ölşenetın qasiet pen ony bıldıretın ölşem bırlıgın ajyrat.

##### Denenıñ massasynyñ fizikalyq mağynasyn tüsındıru

[explainThePhysicalMeaningOfABodysMass.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/measurement/physicalQuantitiesAndUnits/explainThePhysicalMeaningOfABodysMass.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Mass characterizes a body's inertia: under the same applied influence, a more massive body is generally harder to change in motion. Mass must not be equated with gravitational force, which can depend on location.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Massa qozğalystyñ özgeruıne qarsylyqty bıldıretının, tartylys küşı emes ekenın tüsın.

##### Tanys fizikalyq şamağa bırlık tañdau

[selectAUnitForAFamiliarPhysicalQuantity.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/measurement/physicalQuantitiesAndUnits/selectAUnitForAFamiliarPhysicalQuantity.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Choose appropriate units of time, length, and mass in everyday examples without confusing a physical quantity with an object.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Uaqyt, massa jäne ūzyndyq üşın laiyqty ölşem bırlıkterın tañda.

### Mehanika

Groups: 6 · Skills: 21

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Mechanics describes changes in bodies' positions over time, the inertial properties of motion, and the transmission of mechanical action through simple systems. Basic explanations of types of forces and equilibrium are assigned to the neighboring Domain.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Denelerdıñ qalai qozğalatynyn, özgerısterge qarsy tūratynyn jäne mehanikalyq jüieler arqyly qozğalysty qalai beretının zertte.

#### Qozğalysty sipattau

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/describingMotion/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Position, direction, speed, and repetition are needed for a qualitative description of a trajectory; motion is always considered relative to a chosen reference.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Denelerdıñ qaida qozğalatynyn jäne uaqyt öte qozğalystyñ qalai özgeretının sipattaudy üiren.

##### Qozğalys jyldamdyqtaryn salystyru

[compareSpeedsOfMotion.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/describingMotion/compareSpeedsOfMotion.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Speed relates displacement or distance to time; comparisons account for whether the same time intervals or different periods of motion are involved.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Belgılı uaqyt aralyqtarynda denelerdıñ qanşalyqty jyldam qozğalatynyn salystyr.

##### Qozğalys bağytyn sipattau

[describeTheDirectionOfMotion.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/describingMotion/describeTheDirectionOfMotion.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine the direction of a body's velocity or displacement relative to a selected reference frame, distinguishing direction from the total distance traveled.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tañdalğan sanaq jüiesıne qatysty qozğalys bağytyn anyqta.

##### Sanaq nüktesıne qatysty qozğalysty anyqtau

[identifyMotionRelativeToAReferencePoint.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/describingMotion/identifyMotionRelativeToAReferencePoint.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Motion is a change in a body's position relative to a reference frame over time; an object can move relative to one reference and remain stationary relative to another.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Nelıkten dene bır sanaq nüktesıne qatysty qozğalyp, ekınşısıne qatysty tynyş tūra alatynyn tüsındır.

##### Periodtyq qozğalysty tanu

[recognizePeriodicMotion.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/describingMotion/recognizePeriodicMotion.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify recurring physical states and distinguish regular cycles of motion from random or one-time changes in position.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Belgılı bır tūraqty tsiklmen qaitalanatyn qozğalysty tany.

#### İnertsiia jäne qozğalystyñ özgerısterı

Skills: 2

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/inertiaAndChangesInMotion/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A body may continue moving after an applied action ceases, while changes in motion are associated with interaction; accessible models do not require equations of motion.

**User-friendly description (kk):** İnertsiiany jäne onyñ qozğalystyñ özgerısterımen bailanysyn zertte.

##### Bırqalypty jäne bırqalypsyz qozğalysty ajyratu

[distinguishUniformFromNonuniformMotion.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/inertiaAndChangesInMotion/distinguishUniformFromNonuniformMotion.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare successive positions of an object to determine whether it travels equal distances in equal time intervals.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jyldamdyğy tūraqty qozğalys pen uaqyt öte jyldamdyğy özgeretın qozğalysty tany.

##### Qozğalystağy inertsiia körınısterın tanu

[recognizeManifestationsOfInertiaInMotion.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/inertiaAndChangesInMotion/recognizeManifestationsOfInertiaInMotion.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why an object or passenger tends to maintain its previous state of motion during an abrupt change in speed.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jağdai kürt özgerse de qozğalystağy deneler nege qozğalysyn saqtauğa ūmtylatynyn tüsındır.

#### İmpuls jäne soqtyğysular

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/momentumAndCollisions/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Momentum characterizes a body's motion, while collisions demonstrate momentum transfer and change. In the absence of external impulse, the total momentum of a system is conserved regardless of the type of collision.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qozğalystağy denelerdıñ soqtyğysqanda impulspen qalai almasatynyn zertte.

##### Serpımdı jäne serpımsız soqtyğysulardy ajyratu

[distinguishElasticFromInelasticCollisions.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/momentumAndCollisions/distinguishElasticFromInelasticCollisions.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** In an elastic collision, the system's kinetic energy is conserved; in an inelastic collision, some becomes internal energy and deformation. Momentum remains conserved in an isolated system.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Serpımdı jäne serpımsız soqtyğysulardy salystyr, energiianyñ saqtaluyn impulstıñ saqtaluymen şatastyrma.

##### Syzyqtyq impulstıñ saqtaluyn tüsındıru

[explainConservationOfLinearMomentum.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/momentumAndCollisions/explainConservationOfLinearMomentum.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** In the absence of a net external impulse, the total momentum of a system remains constant even though individual bodies change their momenta.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Syrtqy küş impulsı bolmasa jalpy impuls nege tūraqty qalatynyn tüsın.

##### Küş impulsın tüsındıru

[explainImpulse.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/momentumAndCollisions/explainImpulse.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A change in a body's momentum is related to the magnitude and duration of an applied force, which explains physical differences among braking methods.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Belgılı uaqyt boiy äser etetın küş impulstı qalai özgertetının zertte.

##### Syzyqtyq impulstı tüsındıru

[explainLinearMomentum.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/momentumAndCollisions/explainLinearMomentum.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Momentum depends on a body's mass and velocity and has a direction; equal velocities of bodies with different masses do not imply equal momentum.

**User-friendly description (kk):** İmpulstıñ massağa, jyldamdyqqa jäne bağytqa qalai täueldı ekenın tüsındır.

#### Niuton zañdary

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/newtonsLaws/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Newton's laws establish the relationships among forces, inertia, and changes in bodies' motion in the appropriate reference frames.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Niuton zañdarynyñ küşter men qozğalystyñ özgerısterın qalai bailanystyratynyn üiren.

##### Niutonnyñ bırınşı zañyn tüsındıru

[explainNewtonsFirstLaw.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/newtonsLaws/explainNewtonsFirstLaw.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** When the net force is zero, a body's velocity in an inertial reference frame remains constant; rest is a special case.

**User-friendly description (kk):** İnertsiialyq sanaq jüiesınde qorytqy küş nöl bolsa, jyldamdyq nege tūraqty bolatynyn tüsındır.

##### Niutonnyñ ekınşı zañyn tüsındıru

[explainNewtonsSecondLaw.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/newtonsLaws/explainNewtonsSecondLaw.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A body's acceleration is determined by the net force and its mass; under the same force, bodies of different masses change velocity differently.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Küş pen massa üdeudı bırge qalai anyqtaitynyn zertte.

##### Niutonnyñ üşınşı zañyn tüsındıru

[explainNewtonsThirdLaw.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/newtonsLaws/explainNewtonsThirdLaw.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The interaction forces between two bodies are equal in magnitude and opposite in direction but act on different bodies, so they do not cancel on a single body.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ärtürlı denelerge äser etetın şamalary teñ, bağyttary qarama-qarsy özara äser küşterın tany.

#### Ainalmaly qozğalys

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/rotationalMotion/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Rotation involves torque, mass distribution, and inertial properties. Conservation of angular momentum describes a system's motion when there is no net external torque.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ainaldyratyn küşter men massanyñ taraluy ainalmaly qozğalysqa qalai äser etetının zertte.

##### Öz osınıñ ainalasynda ainaludy şeñber boiymen qozğalystan ajyratu

[distinguishRotationAboutAnAxisFromMotionAlongACircle.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/rotationalMotion/distinguishRotationAboutAnAxisFromMotionAlongACircle.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A body's rotation about its own axis differs from the motion of its center along a circular path, during which the direction of velocity changes.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Denenıñ öz osınen ainaluyn şeñber boiymen oryn auystyruynan ajyrat.

##### İmpuls momentınıñ saqtaluyn tüsındıru

[explainConservationOfAngularMomentum.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/rotationalMotion/explainConservationOfAngularMomentum.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** In the absence of net external torque, a system's total angular momentum is conserved.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Syrtqy küşterdıñ qorytqy momentı bolmasa, impuls momentı nege tūraqty qalatynyn tüsın.

##### Ainalu inertsiiasyn tüsındıru

[explainRotationalInertia.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/rotationalMotion/explainRotationalInertia.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The distribution of mass relative to an axis affects how rotation changes, even when the total mass is the same.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Osten alysyraq ornalasqan massa ainalu özgerısıne qarsylyqty qalai arttyratynyn tany.

##### Küş momentın tüsındıru

[explainTorque.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/rotationalMotion/explainTorque.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The turning effect of a force depends on its direction and lever arm relative to the axis, not merely on the force's magnitude.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bır küş iınınıñ ūzyndyğyna qarai denenı nege ärtürlı ainaldyratynyn tüsındır.

#### Qarapaiym mehanizmder

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/simpleMachines/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Levers, pulleys, wheels, and gears demonstrate the transmission of force and rotation. The focus here is on physical principles, not selecting a design or engineering a machine.

**User-friendly description (kk):** İıntırekter, doñğalaqtar, bloktar jäne tıstı berılıster qozğalys pen küştı qalai beretının tüsın.

##### İıntırektıñ jūmysyn tüsındıru

[explainHowALeverWorks.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/simpleMachines/explainHowALeverWorks.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A lever's mechanical advantage depends on distances between the fulcrum and the points where forces are applied; gaining force involves a corresponding change in displacement.

**User-friendly description (kk):** İıntırek küş pen oryn auystyru arasyndağy qatynasty qalai özgertetının zertte.

##### Bloktyñ jūmysyn tüsındıru

[explainHowAPulleyWorks.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/simpleMachines/explainHowAPulleyWorks.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A fixed pulley changes the direction of the applied force, whereas a movable pulley can reduce the force needed by distributing the load across rope segments.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jyljymaityn jäne jyljymaly bloktardyñ küş bağytyn qalai özgertetının nemese jüktı qalai böletının salystyr.

##### Doñğalaq pen ostıñ jūmysyn tüsındıru

[explainHowAWheelAndAxleWork.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/simpleMachines/explainHowAWheelAndAxleWork.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The shared rotation of a wheel and axle transmits motion and changes the relationship between applied forces and displacements; a wheel can also change the nature of friction.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Doñğalaq pen os ainaludy qalai beretının jäne tüsırılgen küşterdı qalai özgertetının tüsın.

##### Ilınısken tıstı doñğalaqtardyñ ainaluyn boljau

[predictTheRotationOfMeshedGears.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/simpleMachines/predictTheRotationOfMeshedGears.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A directly meshed pair of gears rotates in opposite directions, and the ratio of their angular velocities depends on the number of teeth.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ilınısken tıstı doñğalaqtardyñ qalai ainalatynyn jäne tıster sany jyldamdyqqa qalai äser etetının bolja.

### Qazırgı fizika

Groups: 3 · Skills: 16

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Models of atoms, quantum and nuclear phenomena, and spacetime explain observations not covered by classical physics alone. Younger children can encounter the concepts without mathematical formalism.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Kvanttyq qūbylystardy, iadrolyq özgerısterdı jäne keñıstık-uaqyt fizikasyn zertte.

#### Atomdar men kvanttyq qūbylystar

Skills: 5

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/atomsAndQuantumPhenomena/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Atomic models and discrete packets of energy help explain light and properties of matter that cannot be described solely in terms of mechanical motion.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Atom qūrylysy men kvanttyq mınez-qūlyqtyñ klassikalyq modelderden aiyrmasyn bıl.

##### Atomdy negızgı qūramdastarynan ajyratu

[distinguishAnAtomFromItsPrincipalComponents.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/atomsAndQuantumPhenomena/distinguishAnAtomFromItsPrincipalComponents.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** An atom consists of a nucleus and an electron cloud; electrons' motion and states do not correspond to literal planetary orbits.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Atomnyñ iadrodan jäne ony qorşağan kvanttyq küilerdegı elektrondardan tūratynyn tany.

##### Fotondy elektromagnittık säulelenudıñ kvanty retınde tüsındıru

[explainAPhotonAsAQuantumOfElectromagneticRadiation.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/atomsAndQuantumPhenomena/explainAPhotonAsAQuantumOfElectromagneticRadiation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A photon is a quantum of the electromagnetic field whose energy is related to radiation frequency; it should not be interpreted as a tiny classical ball.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Fotondardyñ elektromagnittık säulelenu energiiasynyñ kvanttary ekenın tüsın.

##### Atomnyñ diskrettı energiia küilerın tüsındıru

[explainDiscreteAtomicEnergyStates.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/atomsAndQuantumPhenomena/explainDiscreteAtomicEnergyStates.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Bound states of an atom have definite energies, and transitions between states involve energy absorption or emission.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Atomdardyñ bailanysqan küilerınde diskrettı energiia deñgeilerı bolatynyn tany.

##### Qozğan atomnyñ jaryq şyğaruyn tüsındıru

[explainLightEmissionByAnExcitedAtom.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/atomsAndQuantumPhenomena/explainLightEmissionByAnExcitedAtom.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A transition of an atom between energy states may be accompanied by the emission of a photon whose energy is determined by the difference between those states.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Atomdar energiia deñgeilerın auystyrğanda fotondardy qalai şyğara alatynyn tüsındır.

##### Kvanttyq nysandardyñ tolqyndyq jäne bölşektık qasietın tüsındıru

[explainWaveLikeAndParticleLikeBehaviorOfQuantumObjects.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/atomsAndQuantumPhenomena/explainWaveLikeAndParticleLikeBehaviorOfQuantumObjects.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Light and matter exhibit phenomena that cannot be exhaustively described by only a classical wave or a classical particle picture.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Kvanttyq nysandardyñ tolqynğa da, bölşekke de ūqsas qasietterdı nege körsetetının zertte.

#### İadrolyq qūbylystar

Skills: 6

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/nuclearPhenomena/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Changes in atomic nuclei differ from chemical reactions and may release energy.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Atom iadrolary qalai özgeretının jäne keibır özgerıster nege energiia böletının bıl.

##### Alfa, beta jäne gamma säulelenudı ajyratu

[distinguishAlphaBetaAndGammaRadiation.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/nuclearPhenomena/distinguishAlphaBetaAndGammaRadiation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Alpha radiation consists of helium nuclei, beta radiation of electrons or positrons, and gamma radiation of high-energy photons.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Alfa, beta bölşekterdı jäne gamma fotondardy tany.

##### İadrolyq türlenu men himiialyq özgerıstı ajyratu

[distinguishNuclearTransformationFromChemicalChange.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/nuclearPhenomena/distinguishNuclearTransformationFromChemicalChange.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A nuclear transformation changes an atom's nucleus, whereas chemical reactions primarily change bonds and electronic structure.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Atom iadrosyndağy özgerısterdı himiialyq reaktsiialardan ajyrat.

##### Jartylai ydyrau kezeñın tüsındıru

[explainHalfLife.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/nuclearPhenomena/explainHalfLife.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Half-life describes the statistical decline in the number of unstable nuclei in a population, not the lifetime of an individual nucleus.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jartylai ydyrau kezeñı köptegen tūraqsyz iadrolar üşın statistikalyq zañdylyq ekenın tüsın.

##### İadrolyq bölınudı tüsındıru

[explainNuclearFission.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/nuclearPhenomena/explainNuclearFission.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Heavy nuclei can split into lighter fragments and release energy because of changes in binding energy.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Auyr iadrolardyñ bölınuı energiiany qalai bosatatynyn zertte.

##### İadrolyq sintezdı tüsındıru

[explainNuclearFusion.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/nuclearPhenomena/explainNuclearFusion.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Light nuclei can combine under suitable conditions, and changes in binding energy can lead to energy release.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jeñıl iadrolardyñ bırıguı energiiany qalai bosatatynyn tüsındır.

##### Radioaktivtılıktı tüsındıru

[explainRadioactivity.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/nuclearPhenomena/explainRadioactivity.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Unstable atomic nuclei spontaneously transform while emitting particles or energy; this is not an ordinary chemical reaction.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tūraqsyz atom iadrolary radioaktivtı türlenuge qalai ūşyraitynyn tüsındır.

#### Salystyrmalylyq teoriiasy

Skills: 5

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/relativity/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Special relativity describes how measurements of space and time relate to motion, while general relativity describes gravity as spacetime geometry. They should not be confused with the history of astronomy or require formulas in an introductory curriculum.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qozğalys pen tartylys keñıstık pen uaqyt ölşemderıne qalai äser etetının zertte.

##### Gravitatsiiany keñıstık-uaqyt qisaiuy retınde tüsındıru

[explainGravityAsSpacetimeCurvature.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/relativity/explainGravityAsSpacetimeCurvature.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize the general relativity concept that the distribution of mass and energy affects spacetime geometry; do not treat a rubber-sheet-and-ball analogy as a literal mechanism of gravity.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jalpy salystyrmalylyqta tartylys keñıstık-uaqyttyñ qisaiuynan tuyndaitynyn tüsın.

##### Uaqyt ötuınıñ baqylauşylardyñ salystyrmaly qozğalysyna täueldılıgın tüsındıru

[explainHowThePassageOfTimeDependsOnObserversRelativeMotion.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/relativity/explainHowThePassageOfTimeDependsOnObserversRelativeMotion.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Using a conceptual model, explain why observers moving relative to one another may measure a time interval differently; this is a physical principle, not an animation-use skill.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bır-bırıne qatysty qozğalatyn baqylauşylar nege ärtürlı uaqyt aralyğyn ölşei alatynyn zertte.

##### Gravitatsiianyñ uaqyt ötuıne äserın tüsındıru

[explainTheEffectOfGravityOnThePassageOfTime.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/relativity/explainTheEffectOfGravityOnThePassageOfTime.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The relative rates of clocks can depend on gravitational potential and observation conditions; this is a physical effect of general relativity.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Gravitatsiia sağattardyñ salystyrmaly jüru jyldamdyğyn qalai özgerte alatynyn zertte.

##### Jaryqtyñ gravitatsiialyq auytquyn tüsındıru

[explainTheGravitationalDeflectionOfLight.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/relativity/explainTheGravitationalDeflectionOfLight.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Near massive bodies, spacetime geometry changes light trajectories; this is not refraction at the boundary of two optical media.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Gravitatsiia jaryq jolyn kädımgı optikalyq synusyz qalai ietının tüsındır.

##### Vakuumdağy jaryq jyldamdyğynyñ tūraqtylyğyn arnaiy salystyrmalylyq printsipı retınde tanu

[recognizeTheConstancyOfTheSpeedOfLightInVacuumAsAPrincipleOfSpecialRelativity.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/relativity/recognizeTheConstancyOfTheSpeedOfLightInVacuumAsAPrincipleOfSpecialRelativity.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Using qualitative models, distinguish the invariant speed of light in vacuum for inertial observers from ordinary addition of speeds of everyday objects.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Arnaiy salystyrmalylyqta vakuumdağy jaryq jyldamdyğy barlyq inertsiialyq baqylauşylarğa bırdei ekenın tüsın.

### Molekulalyq fizika

Groups: 3 · Skills: 10

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Particle models help explain physical properties and changes in states of matter. Unlike chemistry, this Domain focuses on particle movement, interactions, and arrangement rather than chemical reactions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bölşekterdıñ qozğalysy men ornalasuy zattyñ qasietterın qalai tüsındıretının zertte.

#### Diffuziia jäne aralasu

Skills: 1

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/diffusionAndMixing/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Random thermal motion can cause particles to spread gradually without deliberate stirring.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bölşekterdıñ retsız qozğalysy zattardyñ taraluy men aralasuyna qalai äkeletının bıl.

##### Diffuziiany tüsındıru

[explainDiffusion.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/diffusionAndMixing/explainDiffusion.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Diffusion results from particles' thermal motion and the gradual equalization of their concentrations without the need for macroscopic mixing.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Diffuziia aralastyrmai-aq qalai jüretının tüsındır.

#### Gazdardyñ qasietterı

Skills: 2

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/gasProperties/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The compressibility of gases and the dependence of their pressure on conditions follow from particle motion and the spaces between particles.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bölşekter modelı arqyly gazdardyñ fizikalyq qasietterın zertte.

##### Gazdardyñ syğylğyştyğyn tüsındıru

[explainGasCompressibility.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/gasProperties/explainGasCompressibility.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compressing a gas reduces the average distances between particles while the sizes of the molecules remain virtually unchanged.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Gazdy nege kışı kölemge deiın syğuğa bolatynyn tüsın.

##### Tūraqty kölemde gaz qysymynyñ temperaturağa täueldılıgın tüsındıru

[explainHowGasPressureDependsOnTemperatureAtConstantVolume.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/gasProperties/explainHowGasPressureDependsOnTemperatureAtConstantVolume.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** At constant volume, increasing a gas's temperature generally increases its pressure because the particles move more vigorously.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Kölem özgermese, temperatura öskende gaz qysymy nege artatynyn tüsındır.

#### Zattyñ bölşektık modelı

Skills: 7

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/particleModelOfMatter/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Substances consist of particles with spaces and interactions between them; the model explains properties without requiring complex formulas.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Körınbeitın bölşekterdıñ özara ärekettesıp, zatty qalai qūraitynyn bıl.

##### Qatty, sūiyq jäne gaz küilerındegı bölşekter ornalasuyn salystyru

[compareParticleArrangementsInSolidsLiquidsAndGases.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/particleModelOfMatter/compareParticleArrangementsInSolidsLiquidsAndGases.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Particles in solids mostly oscillate around fixed positions; in liquids, particles can move relative to one another; and in gases they have much greater freedom of movement and characteristic interparticle distances.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qatty zattardağy, sūiyqtardağy jäne gazdardağy bölşekterdıñ ornalasuyn salystyr.

##### Gaz qysymyn bölşekter qozğalysymen tüsındıru

[explainGasPressureThroughParticleMotion.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/particleModelOfMatter/explainGasPressureThroughParticleMotion.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The combined collisions of particles with the vessel walls produce force per unit area, that is, pressure.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Köptegen bölşektıñ qabyrğağa soqtyğysuy qysymdy qalai tudyratynyn tüsındır.

##### Bölşekterdıñ retsız jylulyq qozğalysyn tüsındıru

[explainRandomThermalMotionOfParticles.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/particleModelOfMatter/explainRandomThermalMotionOfParticles.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Particles of matter are constantly moving, but not all at the same speed; the type of motion depends on the physical state.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bölşekter nege ünemı türlı bağytta jäne jyldamdyqpen qozğalatynyn tüsın.

##### Zattyñ bölşektık qūrylysyn tüsındıru

[explainTheParticulateStructureOfMatter.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/particleModelOfMatter/explainTheParticulateStructureOfMatter.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Demonstrate that even water in a transparent glass consists of particles invisible to the naked eye.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Zattyñ tıkelei köruge tym kışkentai bölşekterden tūratynyn tüsındır.

##### Zat küilerınıñ qasietterın bölşekter qozğalysymen tüsındıru

[explainThePropertiesOfStatesOfMatterThroughParticleMotion.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/particleModelOfMatter/explainThePropertiesOfStatesOfMatterThroughParticleMotion.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Differences in the arrangement, motion, and interactions of particles explain the properties of solids, liquids, and gases.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bölşekterdıñ qozğalysy men ärekettesuı arqyly qatty, sūiyq, gaz küilerınıñ qasietterın tüsındır.

##### Jylulyq ūlğaiudy bölşekter qozğalysy men ärekettesuımen tüsındıru

[explainThermalExpansionThroughParticleMotionAndInteractions.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/particleModelOfMatter/explainThermalExpansionThroughParticleMotionAndInteractions.ts)
