**Methodological description (English):** Heating often changes the average distances between particles, not the sizes of the molecules themselves.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ūlğaiu kezınde ädette bölşekter ölşemı emes, araqaşyqtyğy özgeretının tüsın.

##### Bölşekter qozğalysyn temperatura özgerısterımen bailanystyru

[relateParticleMotionToTemperatureChanges.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/particleModelOfMatter/relateParticleMotionToTemperatureChanges.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Using an animation, explain why average particle motion generally becomes more vigorous when heated.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qyzdyrudy bölşekterdıñ ädettegı qozğalysynyñ özgerısterımen bailanystyr.

### Optika

Groups: 5 · Skills: 11

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Optics studies the propagation of light, image formation, and the interaction of light rays with surfaces, water, and lenses. The broader electromagnetic radiation spectrum is classified separately.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Körınetın jaryqtyñ qalai taralyp, şağylyp, synyp, keskın tüzetının zertte.

#### Jaryq pen köleñkeler

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/lightAndShadows/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Obstacles and the source's position determine a shadow's appearance, direction, and size; a model enables qualitative predictions.

##### Köleñkenıñ qalai paida bolatynyn tüsındıru

[explainHowAShadowForms.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/lightAndShadows/explainHowAShadowForms.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate a shadow to the blocking of light by an opaque object.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Möldır emes zat jaryqty bögep, köleñkenı qalai tudyratynyn tüsındır.

##### Köleñke ölşemınıñ özgeruın boljau

[predictChangesInShadowSize.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/lightAndShadows/predictChangesInShadowSize.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine how changing their relative positions affects shadow size.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jaryq közın ne zatty jyljytqanda köleñkenıñ ölşemı qalai özgeretının tüsın.

##### Köleñkenıñ ornalasuyn boljau

[predictThePositionOfAShadow.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/lightAndShadows/predictThePositionOfAShadow.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Predict where a shadow forms given the positions of the source and object.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Zattyñ qai jağynda köleñke tüsetının bolja.

#### Jaryqtyñ şağyluy

Skills: 2

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/lightReflection/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A surface changes the direction of a light ray; mirrors provide a visible model of this behavior.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jaryq şağyldyratyn betke tüskende bağytyn qalai özgertetının zertte.

##### Şağylğan säulenıñ bağytyn boljau

[predictTheDirectionOfAReflectedRay.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/lightReflection/predictTheDirectionOfAReflectedRay.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** According to the law of reflection, the angle between the ray and the surface normal is the same for incident and reflected rays.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Betke tūrğyzylğan normalğa qatysty şağylu būryştaryn bolja.

##### Jaryqtyñ şağyluyn tanu

[recognizeLightReflection.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/lightReflection/recognizeLightReflection.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify situations in which light returns from a surface.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jaryqtyñ betten qaşan şağylatynyn tany.

#### Jaryq közderı men körınu

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/lightSourcesAndVisibility/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** An object is visible when light from it reaches the eye; a light source and an illuminated surface play different roles.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Nelıkten keibır deneler jaryq şyğaryp, basqalary şağylğan jaryq arqyly körınetının bıl.

##### Tabiği jäne jasandy jaryq közderın jıkteu

[classifyNaturalAndArtificialLightSources.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/lightSourcesAndVisibility/classifyNaturalAndArtificialLightSources.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Group light sources according to their origin.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tabiği jäne adam jasağan jaryq közderın tany.

##### Jaryq közı men jaryqtanğan denenı ajyratu

[distinguishALightSourceFromAnIlluminatedBody.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/lightSourcesAndVisibility/distinguishALightSourceFromAnIlluminatedBody.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize a body that emits light and one that reflects it.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jaryq şyğaratyn dene men tek jaryqtanatyn denenı ajyrat.

##### Zattyñ körınu şartyn tüsındıru

[explainTheConditionForAnObjectToBeVisible.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/lightSourcesAndVisibility/explainTheConditionForAnObjectToBeVisible.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify the need for light from an object to reach the eye.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Zattan şyqqan ne şağylğan jaryq közge jetkende ğana ony nege köretınımızdı tüsındır.

#### Jaryqtyñ synuy jäne linzalar

Skills: 2

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/refractionAndLenses/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Moving between media and the shape of a lens affect ray direction and image formation.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jaryq ärtürlı orta şekarasynan jäne linzalardan ötkende qalai bağyt özgertetının zertte.

##### Jinağyş jäne şaşyratqyş linzalardy ajyratu

[distinguishConvergingAndDivergingLenses.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/refractionAndLenses/distinguishConvergingAndDivergingLenses.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use a simulation to observe how different lenses change the directions of light rays passing through them.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jaryq säulelerın jinaityn jäne şaşyratatyn linzalardy salystyr.

##### Ortalar şekarasyndağy jaryqtyñ synuyn tüsındıru

[explainLightRefractionAtTheBoundaryBetweenMedia.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/refractionAndLenses/explainLightRefractionAtTheBoundaryBetweenMedia.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** When light passes between media with different optical properties, its speed changes and, at oblique incidence, so does the direction of the light wave.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jaryq ekı ortanyñ şekarasynda bağytyn qalai özgerte alatynyn tüsındır.

#### Möldırlık

Skills: 1

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/transparency/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Transparency characterizes the transmission, absorption, and scattering of visible light by a material and its ability to transmit an image.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Materialdar ötkızetın jaryq mölşerı men aiqyndylyğy boiynşa qalai erekşelenetının bıl.

##### Materialdardy möldırlıgı boiynşa jıkteu

[classifyMaterialsByTransparency.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/transparency/classifyMaterialsByTransparency.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish transparent, translucent, and opaque materials by their ability to transmit light and form a clear image through the material.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Möldır, şala möldır jäne möldır emes materialdardy ajyrat.

### Säulelenu

Groups: 2 · Skills: 5

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/radiation/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Radiation describes energy transfer from a source through space, including invisible parts of the electromagnetic spectrum and their interaction with matter. Geometric image formation with light belongs to Optics.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Elektromagnittık säulelenudı jäne onyñ zatpen ärekettesuın zertte.

#### Elektromagnittık säulelenu

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/radiation/electromagneticRadiation/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Radio waves, infrared, visible, and ultraviolet radiation are different regions of the electromagnetic spectrum.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Elektromagnittık spektrdıñ körınetın jäne körınbeitın bölıkterın tany.

##### Körınetın jäne körınbeitın elektromagnittık säulelenudı ajyratu

[distinguishVisibleFromInvisibleElectromagneticRadiation.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/radiation/electromagneticRadiation/distinguishVisibleFromInvisibleElectromagneticRadiation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use lamp light, infrared radiation, and radio waves to demonstrate that not all radiation can be detected by the eye.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Radiotolqyndar men infraqyzyl säulelenu adam közıne körınbeitının tüsın.

##### Elektromagnittık tolqyndardyñ auasyz taraluyn tüsındıru

[explainThePropagationOfElectromagneticWavesWithoutAir.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/radiation/electromagneticRadiation/explainThePropagationOfElectromagneticWavesWithoutAir.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use sunlight to explain why electromagnetic radiation can propagate through the vacuum of space.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Elektromagnittık tolqyndar ğaryş vakuumynda nege tarala alatynyn tüsındır.

##### Tanys säulelenu türlerın elektromagnittık spektrmen bailanystyru

[relateFamiliarTypesOfRadiationToTheElectromagneticSpectrum.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/radiation/electromagneticRadiation/relateFamiliarTypesOfRadiationToTheElectromagneticSpectrum.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Radio waves, infrared, visible, and ultraviolet radiation occupy positions in the spectrum according to frequency and wavelength; visibility does not determine their physical nature.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tanys säulelenu türlerınıñ elektromagnittık spektrdegı ornyn tap.

#### Säulelenu jäne zat

Skills: 2

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/radiation/radiationAndMatter/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Materials can emit, reflect, transmit, or absorb energy; the outcomes depend on the type of radiation and the properties of matter.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Materialdar säulelenudı qalai jūtyp, şyğaryp, şağyldyryp ne ötkızetının zertte.

##### Energiia şyğarudy tüsken jaryqtyñ şağyluynan ajyratu

[distinguishEnergyEmissionFromReflectionOfReceivedLight.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/radiation/radiationAndMatter/distinguishEnergyEmissionFromReflectionOfReceivedLight.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Using the Sun and Moon, explain that a source emits energy while an illuminated body can reflect it.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Közden şyqqan jaryq pen deneden şağylğan jaryqty ajyrat.

##### Säulelenudı jūtu arqyly qyzudy tüsındıru

[explainHeatingThroughRadiationAbsorption.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/radiation/radiationAndMatter/explainHeatingThroughRadiationAbsorption.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Using two surfaces in sunlight, relate differences in heating to energy absorption.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bırdei säulelenu äserınde ärtürlı betterdıñ nege türlışe qyzatynyn tüsındır.

### Termodinamika

Groups: 4 · Skills: 15

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Thermal processes describe changes in temperature, energy transfer, and transitions between states of matter. Macroscopic observations are distinguished from particle-level explanations in the neighboring Domain.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Temperaturany, qyzdyrudy, energiianyñ berıluın jäne zat küiınıñ özgeruın zertte.

#### Jylu berılu mehanizmderı

Skills: 5

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/heatTransferMechanisms/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Thermal energy is transferred through particle interactions, liquid or gas motion, or electromagnetic radiation. Several mechanisms may act simultaneously in a single process.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jyludyñ zat arqyly, ağyp jatqan sūiyqtar men gazdar jäne säulelenu arqyly qalai berıletının bıl.

##### Jylu ötkızgıştıktı zat arqyly energiia berıluı retınde tüsındıru

[explainConductionAsEnergyTransferThroughMatter.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/heatTransferMechanisms/explainConductionAsEnergyTransferThroughMatter.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Using a metal spoon heated in hot water, explain energy transfer without bulk movement of the entire substance.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Zattyñ tūtastai ağuynsyz jylu qalai ötkızıletının tüsındır.

##### Konvektsiiany sūiyq pen gaz ağyny arqyly energiia berıluı retınde tüsındıru

[explainConvectionAsEnergyTransferByFluidFlow.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/heatTransferMechanisms/explainConvectionAsEnergyTransferByFluidFlow.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Convection carries thermal energy with macroscopic motion of a liquid or gas; distinguish it from conduction without bulk material flow.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qozğalatyn sūiyqtar men gazdardyñ jylu energiiasyn qalai tasymaldaitynyn anyqta.

##### Säulelenu arqyly jylu berıluın tüsındıru

[explainRadiativeHeatTransfer.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/heatTransferMechanisms/explainRadiativeHeatTransfer.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Using heat from the Sun or fire, demonstrate energy transfer by electromagnetic waves without contact or moving air.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Elektromagnittık säulelenu materialdyq ortasyz jyludy qalai tasymaldaitynyn tüsındır.

##### Fizikalyq jağdaida jylu berılu mehanizmın anyqtau

[identifyTheHeatTransferMechanismFromAPhysicalSituation.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/heatTransferMechanisms/identifyTheHeatTransferMechanismFromAPhysicalSituation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** For a hot spoon, heated water, or sunlight, select and justify conduction, convection, radiation, or a combination of them. This is an integrative competency, not three separate tests combined in one task.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Berılgen jağdaida jylu berıluınıñ qandai protsesterı jüretının anyqta.

##### Jylu berılu bağytyn boljau

[predictTheDirectionOfHeatTransfer.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/heatTransferMechanisms/predictTheDirectionOfHeatTransfer.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** In the absence of external work, heat spontaneously flows from a warmer body to a colder one until thermal equilibrium is reached.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Temperaturalary ärtürlı deneler arasynda jylu energiiasy qai bağytta berıletının bolja.

#### Fazalyq auysular

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/phaseTransitions/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Melting, freezing, evaporation, and condensation link thermal conditions to changes of state of the same substance.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qyzdyru men salqyndatu zattyñ agregattyq küiın qalai özgerte alatynyn bıl.

##### Bulanu men qainaudy ajyratu

[distinguishEvaporationFromBoiling.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/phaseTransitions/distinguishEvaporationFromBoiling.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Boiling produces vapor bubbles throughout the volume of a liquid, whereas evaporation occurs at its surface.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qainau kezınde paida bolatyn köpırşıkterdı betkı bulanudan ajyrat.

##### Mūzdyñ eruın sudyñ qatuynan ajyratu

[distinguishMeltingFromFreezingOfWater.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/phaseTransitions/distinguishMeltingFromFreezingOfWater.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Melting changes a substance from solid to liquid, while freezing is the reverse; both are phase transitions of the same substance.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Mūzdyñ eruı men sūiyq sudyñ qatuyn ajyrat.

##### Kondensatsiiany tüsındıru

[explainCondensation.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/phaseTransitions/explainCondensation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Condensation is the transition of matter from gas to liquid, including the formation of droplets from water vapor.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Kondensatsiia kezınde gazdyñ sūiyqqa qalai ainalatynyn anyqta.

##### Bulanudy tüsındıru

[explainEvaporation.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/phaseTransitions/explainEvaporation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaporation is the transition of particles from the surface of a liquid into the gas phase and can occur without boiling.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Sūiyqtyñ qainamai-aq betınen qalai bulanatynyn tüsındır.

#### Temperatura jäne qyzdyru

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/temperatureAndHeating/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Temperature characterizes thermal state but is not the same as a subjective feeling of warmth or cold; heating and cooling are changes of state.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ölşengen temperatura men jyludy sezınudıñ aiyrmasyn üiren.

##### Denelerdıñ temperaturasyn salystyru

[compareObjectsTemperatures.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/temperatureAndHeating/compareObjectsTemperatures.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Temperature characterizes a body's thermal state; valid comparisons rely on measurements, not the intensity of subjective warmth.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Temperaturany tek qolmen sezıp emes, aspaptarmen ölşep salystyr.

##### Temperatura men jylu sezımın ajyratu

[distinguishTemperatureFromTheSensationOfWarmth.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/temperatureAndHeating/distinguishTemperatureFromTheSensationOfWarmth.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why the sensation of touch is not always an accurate measure of temperature.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Temperaturasy bırdei ekı dene nege ūstağanda ärtürlı sezıluı mümkın ekenın tüsındır.

##### Salqyndaudy tanu

[recognizeCooling.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/temperatureAndHeating/recognizeCooling.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A decrease in temperature can accompany energy transfer to the surroundings or changes in a system's physical state.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Salqyndaudy denenıñ jylulyq küiınıñ fizikalyq özgerısı retınde anyqta.

##### Qyzdyrudy tanu

[recognizeHeating.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/temperatureAndHeating/recognizeHeating.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** An increase in temperature reflects a change in thermal state, but energy input does not always increase temperature during a phase transition.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qyzdyru kezınde denenıñ jylulyq küiınıñ özgerısterın anyqta.

#### Jylu oqşaulau

Skills: 2

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/thermalInsulation/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Insulating materials slow down energy transfer but do not create energy themselves; this differs from describing the three mechanisms of heat exchange.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Oqşaulau jyludyñ berıluın qalai baiaulatatynyn zertte.

##### Materialdardyñ jylu oqşaulau qasietterın salystyru

[compareMaterialsThermalInsulationProperties.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/thermalInsulation/compareMaterialsThermalInsulationProperties.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine from experimental results which material slows heat transfer more effectively.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Materialdardy qajetsız jylu berıluın qanşalyqty azaitatyny boiynşa salystyr.

##### Temperaturany saqtau üşın material tañdau

[selectAMaterialForMaintainingTemperature.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/thermalInsulation/selectAMaterialForMaintainingTemperature.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Choose an insulator for a simple everyday task and justify the choice using the material's properties.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Temperaturany saqtaudyñ naqty qajettılıgıne sai oqşaulağyş materialdy tañda.

### Tolqyndar

Groups: 4 · Skills: 23

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Oscillations produce recurring disturbances that can propagate through water, air, and other media. Sound is one manifestation, while wave patterns are visible on the surface of water.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Terbelısterdı, dybysty jäne tolqynnyñ taraluy men özara äserın zertte.

#### Akustika

Skills: 8

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/acoustics/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Loudness, pitch, and the propagation of sound through a medium are related to oscillation properties; auditory experiences can be explored with safe simulations.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Terbelıs pen dybys taraluy estuımızge qalai äser etetının zertte.

##### Dybystardyñ qattylyğyn salystyru

[compareTheLoudnessOfSounds.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/acoustics/compareTheLoudnessOfSounds.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Loudness is the perception of sound intensity and also depends on frequency and hearing sensitivity; compare it independently of pitch.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Dybystardyñ qanşalyq qatty estıletının salystyr, qattylyqty dybys biıktıgımen şatastyrma.

##### Joğary jäne tömen dybystardy ajyratu

[distinguishHighPitchedFromLowPitchedSounds.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/acoustics/distinguishHighPitchedFromLowPitchedSounds.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Pitch is primarily related to the frequency of sound oscillations, not amplitude, which affects intensity.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Dybys tolqyndarynyñ jiılıgıne qarap joğary jäne tömen tondy tany.

##### Jañğyryqty dybys şağyluy dep tüsındıru

[explainAnEchoAsSoundReflection.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/acoustics/explainAnEchoAsSoundReflection.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Using an echo in an empty room, recognize a returning sound wave after it interacts with a surface.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jañğyryqty betınen şağylyp qaitqan dybys tolqyny dep tüsındır.

##### Dybys qattylyğynyñ terbelıs amplitudasyna täueldılıgın tüsındıru

[explainHowSoundLoudnessDependsOnOscillationAmplitude.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/acoustics/explainHowSoundLoudnessDependsOnOscillationAmplitude.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** All else being equal, a greater sound-pressure amplitude means greater intensity, although perceived loudness also depends on frequency.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Joğary dybys amplitudasyn qarqyndylyqpen bailanystyryp, qabyldaudy da esker.

##### Dybys biıktıgınıñ terbelıs jiılıgıne täueldılıgın tüsındıru

[explainHowSoundPitchDependsOnOscillationFrequency.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/acoustics/explainHowSoundPitchDependsOnOscillationFrequency.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** All else being equal, a higher sound frequency corresponds to a higher pitch; it is not the same as increased loudness.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Joğary dybys jiılıgın joğary estıletın tonmen bailanystyr.

##### Qaşyqtyqpen dybystyñ älsıreuın tüsındıru

[explainSoundAttenuationWithDistance.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/acoustics/explainSoundAttenuationWithDistance.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** As a wave spreads from a localized source, its energy is generally distributed over an increasing area, reducing intensity; absorption also affects sound levels.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Közden alystağanda dybys ädette nege älsıreitının tüsın.

##### Köz ben tyñdauşy salystyrmaly qozğalğanda ton özgeruın tüsındıru

**Methodological description (English):** For an unchanged sound emitted by a source, explain the Doppler effect: the frequency heard by the observer is higher as the source approaches and lower as it moves away. Do not confuse this frequency change with loudness or engine revolutions.

**Methodological description (English):** Sound requires an elastic material medium, in which pressure or deformation oscillations pass between adjacent parts of matter; mechanical sound does not propagate in a vacuum.

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/oscillations/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Repetitive motion around a given state allows vibration, periodicity, and sound sources to be described.

[recognizeOscillatoryMotion.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/oscillations/recognizeOscillatoryMotion.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Oscillation is a change in a physical state around equilibrium that may recur; not every motion involving reversals is harmonic oscillation.

[recognizeThePeriodicityOfOscillations.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/oscillations/recognizeThePeriodicityOfOscillations.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A periodic oscillation repeats a physical state at equal time intervals; not every motion that changes direction is periodic.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bırdei uaqyt aralyqtarymen qaitalanatyn terbelıstı tany.

[relateSoundToVibration.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/oscillations/relateSoundToVibration.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Sound arises when an oscillating source disturbs an elastic medium; oscillation without a medium does not produce a mechanical sound wave.

[index.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/wavePhenomena/index.ts)

[explainResonance.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/wavePhenomena/explainResonance.ts)

[explainWaveDiffraction.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/wavePhenomena/explainWaveDiffraction.ts)

[explainWaveInterference.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/wavePhenomena/explainWaveInterference.ts)
